name: Agent
blurb: An AI agent you set up in plain words. It replies and reacts how you tell it to, channel by channel, using your own Claude API key.

name: GCoin
blurb: A currency that follows you across every server. Earn it, send it, and climb the wallets.

name: GTrade
blurb: Craft image items, show them off, and trade them directly or through the server's market.

name: Hype
blurb: Set up automatic replies and emoji reactions that fire when a message matches a pattern.

name: Music
blurb: Play searches, video links, livestreams and playlists from YouTube in your voice channel, with full queue controls and Spotify sync.

name: Storms
blurb: Surprise number-guessing storms. Guess from 1 to 200 or bet your GCoin, with up to a x10 multiplier for a quick win.

name: Who Dis
blurb: Chat anonymously with a random member of your server. Guess who they are to win GCoin.
